bullets.note: This is a Scooby Snack for all the Japanophiles out there. These 10–15-minute episodes are perfect as emergency pick-me-ups. Here’s the description: “Children go on errands all by themselves for the very first time as a camera crew follows along in this beloved, long-running reality show from Japan.” Hat tip to JZ for this gem. いつもお世話になっております, JZ-kun!
